''See also: [[Silent King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent King is a [[Dreadgod]], an entity of immense power that exists on a [[scale]] far beyond mortal understanding. Though often perceived by mortals as the weakest of its kind, it is a formidable being capable of projecting illusions that can engage [[Monarchs]] in combat. Its most lethal attribute is its mental assault, which allows it to influence the minds of dreamers across the planet. Physically, it is described as a relatively small [[Dreadgod]] that takes the form of a [[giant]] white tiger with an oversized halo. The Silent King maintains a vast kingdom within the jungle, where it manages a mental web that grants its subjects—including spirits, remnants, and [[sacred beasts]]—unusual levels of intelligence and awareness. It is supported by the [[Silent Servants]], a cult known for its use of spying, brainwashing, and deception. For a long period, the King's influence was restricted by the [[Monarch]] [[Emriss Silentborn]], who sealed it away. The entity is also associated with various artifacts, such as the [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker|Silent King Bow]] and a crown that acts as a power amplifier. Ultimately, the Silent King was killed by the [[Void Sage]], [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent King is a [[giant]] white tiger with black stripes and smooth pale skin. This entity features a face resembling a detailed [[Remnant]], white crowns that shine as bright as the sun, and a halo.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A subtle and insidious [[Dreadgod]], this entity maintains its mental faculties unlike its siblings. It is driven by a desire for revenge against [[Emriss Silentborn]] and uses its [[willpower]] to withstand intense [[hunger]] urges.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent King seeks revenge against [[Emriss Silentborn]] and has threatened the friends and family of [[Lindon]]. It once had a cult known as the [[Silent Servants]] led by [[Kahn Mala]], and its power corrupted [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]]. Additionally, the entity's death empowered the [[Weeping Dragon]] and it was once swapped with the [[Wandering Titan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This [[Dreadgod]] possesses [[hunger madra]] and uses [[spiritual perception]] to monitor its kingdom. Its powers include mental assaults, a parasitic [[technique]], and the ability to control the minds of the masses or possess [[Remnants]]. It can also fuel illusions, including illusory clones that are solid enough to trade blows with [[Monarchs]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The battle of Moongrave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|During the battle of [[Moongrave]], the Silent King's [[dream technique]] washed over the area as his will and various techniques were present in the conflict.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref> A halo accompanies the Silent King, who utilizes a [[technique]] capable of controlling the minds of the masses and ordered the [[Golds]] to go wild within the city.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16" /> The Silent King exerts significant control over [[Remnants]] and can possess members of [[Redmoon Hall]] to bolster their [[willpower]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> While his thralls attempted to attack [[Yerin]], [[Lindon]] identified the [[Dreadgod]]'s halo as the Silent King.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" /> This [[Dreadgod]] appears as a [[giant]] white tiger with smooth pale skin, black stripes, and a face resembling a detailed [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> His crown shines as brightly as the sun while his army fights in the distance.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> Though his [[madra]] can be identified by eating it, his deadliest power is a mental assault.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> Despite being a small [[Dreadgod]] and considered the weakest of his kind, he is a figure whose victory [[Lindon]] sees in a dream.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After [[Lindon]] consumed the Silent King, he utilized the entity's [[spirit]], which was composed of tendons, bones, and other materials.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> These body materials were repurposed to craft [[Lindon]]'s special arrows and purple orbs.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> The modified [[madra]] of the Silent King also serves to stimulate [[Lindon]]'s [[Dreadgod arm]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref> The Silent King possesses [[madra]] that produces [[white light]] and can project illusions solid enough to trade blows with [[Monarchs]], a [[technique]] [[Lindon]] has used himself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> Following the death of the Silent King, the [[Weeping Dragon]] was empowered.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] has [[madra]] that produces [[white light]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] can project illusions solid enough to trade blows with [[Monarchs]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Weeping Dragon|The Weeping Dragon]] was empowered by the death of the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] has died.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] used materials from the [[Silent King]] to create purple orbs.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Wandering Titan swap}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Silent King was compelled to undergo a swap with the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Unlike the Silent King, the [[binding]] of the [[Weeping Dragon]] functions more like a normal [[binding]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /> A halo associated with the Silent King acts as a [[Goldsign]] for the [[Silent Servants]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref> During certain events, the [[scale]] of [[Dross]]'s [[dream aura]] was a temporary match to that of the Silent King.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] was forced to swap places with the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Weeping Dragon{{!}}The Weeping Dragon's [[binding]] is more like a normal [[binding]] than the [[Silent King]]’s.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]] is associated with a halo that serves as a [[Goldsign]] for the [[Silent Servants]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[scale]] of [[Dross]]'s [[dream aura]] temporarily matched the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Historical accounts}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent King once challenged the wards of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]] but was ultimately defeated.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 1</ref> The pure-[[white halo]] of the Silent King is worn by [[Dross]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> [[Kahn Mala]] previously served as the cult leader for the Silent King.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c8">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 8</ref> The [[Wandering Titan]] eventually traded places with the Silent King.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Silent King]] challenged the wards of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]] and was defeated.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Dross]] wears the pure-[[white halo]] of the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Kahn Mala]] was the former cult leader of the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Silent King]] was traded places with by the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“The Silent King is theoretically the most vulnerable of the Dreadgods, yet we were no more successful in damaging it there than anywhere else.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“The Silent King’s body is in hiding,” Emriss continued,<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Silent King’s voice from the door was amused. “Intruders. How bold.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“Lindon,” the Silent King whispered into his mind, “I keep my promises.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“The Silent King can exert greater control over Remnants,” the Sage said.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" />}}
